scope: conditional commissioned input profiles, throughout actual startup; reusable on a Live word only when the same bounds continue to hold
direction_budget_definition: Let u(t)=R(t)*(-a_raw(t))/||a_raw(t)|| in the true world frame, with world-down e3=(0,0,1). The total direction ERROR r(t)=u(t)-e3 satisfies r(t)=m(t)+d xi(t)/dt almost everywhere, with one absolutely continuous xi on the same startup history. The budgets include retained true bias and residual. This is an additional temporal source premise, not a consequence of peak noise or BRMM translation alone; no derivative of the noise itself is required.

BMI270_COMMISSIONED_V1.selection_basis: RMS noise at 200 Hz is 1.51 mg for acceleration and 0.07/0.09 dps for gyro under the stated modes. The selected vector peaks include substantial headroom plus commissioned residual scale, cross-axis and acquisition errors. They are explicit engineering requirements, not statistical guarantees. Uncompensated offset and drift remain in BIAS0/1/2.

MPU6886_COMMISSIONED_V1.selection_basis: The table lists 1.0/1.7 mg RMS acceleration noise and 0.04/0.1 dps RMS gyro noise at 100 Hz bandwidth, with characterization qualifications. Larger residual peaks allow more scale/cross-axis/acquisition error than the BMI270 profile. Board offsets can exceed the retained BIAS envelope, so an uncommissioned board is not automatically admitted.
